summary: Replaced the no-change draft with a successor experiment that targets the parent investigation's registered gap 838461385f784f74af057837ff488a66-gap-3 (is the reported index drift bounded or repaired by anything inside the sealed configuration?). The harness draft/assurance_generated.rs gains one case, stopsign_drift_bound_probe: after the lineage prefix (six indices of content, StopSign decided) it runs eight further two-follower re-synchronization rounds, elects node 1 - one of the inflated followers - as the new leader, and runs three more rounds in which the remaining replicas re-synchronize with that new leader. Each round samples every node under its own event name (BOUND_R{k}_N{pid}) and reports accepted/decided indices, decided_eq_accepted, is_reconfigured, the reads of indices 5 and 6, and the decided-log read from 0; each round's drain plus samples and the leader change run under catch_unwind so a handler or storage panic surfaces as BOUND_STAGES.panics instead of aborting the run. The experiment request (parent investigation, previous_id 6f9f0adaec774fc288adf47c6e280c27-experiment, ten source ids, two prerequisite aliases, eight comparisons including the no-repair checks after the leader change and a panics-eq-0 check) is declared for fresh execution; the harness copy under draft/omnipaxos/tests/ matches the draft byte-for-byte and validate returns valid with execution_requested=true. No knowledge, investigation or interpretation records were changed: the drift account and its four witnessed consequence classes stand, and no conclusion is drawn before the receipt exists. Incomplete: the trim child's storage-route gap (b26c13954e184cd2b9fdfda975aff136-gap-4) and the snapshot discriminator's equal-index, follower-side and peer-side variants remain open, and the drift's magnitude after the leader change is a prediction, not yet a measurement.
